content.short: Balus is a content platform on TON that combines social sharing with digital asset trading.
content.description: Balus is a dynamic SocialFi application on the TON blockchain designed to bridge the gap between creative content and digital asset markets. It provides users with a platform to share their media while offering integrated tools to trade that content through NFT and fractional ownership models. Balus aims to simplify the process of turning social engagement into tradable Web3 assets, empowering creators to monetize their influence and providing users with new ways to invest in the creative economy of the TON network.
content.meta: Share and trade creative content on Balus. The intersection of Social and DeFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
